$comment: Approved-asset records. Missing fields are left null rather than invented; a null means not yet established, never a guess. Status: draft | needs-review | approved | superseded.

assets.role: Compact mascot mark and the rig every motion state drives
assets.provenance: Hand-authored SVG. Original geometry, not generated and not traced from any reference image. Informed by packages/ui/src/components/frog-mark.tsx, which already separated eye, pupil and mouth into token roles.
assets.license: Original work for Froggy. No third-party mark or mascot reproduced.
assets.notes: Revision 4. r2 removed a lime rim light that read as a drip on the cheek at 128px. r3 lowered and softened the jaw shading, which had been reading as a second chin under the mouth, and added the lime tongue for success. r4 fixed the eyelid travel: the lid rect bottom sits at y=13 and the sclera starts at y=12.8, so the earlier open/closed/half values all left the lid above the eye and both the blink and the stopped pose were invisible.

assets.role: Isolated preview proving the five-state contract
assets.provenance: Generated from the mark by design/preproduction/tools/build-prototype.mjs, seven stamps with per-instance clip ids.
assets.notes: No dependency, no network, no production endpoint, no secret. Geometry is generated, never hand-copied, because CSS cannot reach inside an SVG <use> shadow tree and a hand-copy would drift.
